name: gmail-mcp
description: Search, read, and draft email across multiple Gmail and Outlook (Microsoft 365) accounts at once, including attachments.
long_description:
A local MCP server for people with more than one mailbox. Mix any number of Gmail and Outlook / Microsoft 365 accounts, each addressed by a short alias (e.g. 'personal', 'work').

- **Multi-account**: search one account or all of them in a single call.
- **Gmail + Outlook together**: each alias picks its provider; Gmail query syntax and Microsoft Graph KQL are both supported.
- **Attachments**: list attachments and read PDFs and text files inline; other files are saved to ~/Downloads/gmail-mcp/.
- **Draft-then-send**: Claude only creates drafts; sending is a separate, explicit step.
- **Local tokens**: OAuth tokens stay on this computer in ~/.gmail-mcp/tokens.db.

After installing, create ~/.gmail-mcp/config.json listing your accounts, then ask Claude to run `setup_status` and `authorize_account` for each alias. You need your own Google OAuth client and/or Azure app registration (see the project README).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List configured mail accounts, their provider (Gmail or Outlook), and auth status.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search one account using Gmail query syntax or Microsoft Graph KQL.

tools.name: search_all_accounts
tools.description: Run the same search across every authorized account.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full body of a message.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft in a chosen account. Does not send.

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a previously created draft after the user confirms.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List labels / folders in an account.

tools.name: modify_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels on a message (archive, mark read, star, trash).

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments on a message.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.description: Read an attachment: PDF and text inline, other files saved to ~/Downloads/gmail-mcp/.

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: Show config file location, which accounts are authorized, and missing settings.

tools.name: authorize_account
tools.description: Open the browser sign-in flow for a configured account alias.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Desktop-app OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console. Needed only for Gmail accounts.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret for the Google OAuth client above. Needed only for Gmail accounts.

microsoft_client_id.title: Microsoft Application (client) ID
microsoft_client_id.description: Azure app registration client ID (public client flows enabled). Needed only for Outlook accounts.

microsoft_tenant_id.title: Microsoft Directory (tenant) ID
microsoft_tenant_id.description: Your tenant ID, or 'common' (any Microsoft account) / 'consumers' (personal outlook.com). Needed only for Outlook accounts.

config_path.title: Accounts config file (optional)
config_path.description: Path to a config.json listing your account aliases. Leave empty to use ~/.gmail-mcp/config.json.
